chunks: ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār asked him about this issue, and he said:
"He does not make up the sawm (fasting) nor the salat (prayer), and everything over which Allah has overcome him, then Allah is more deserving of the excuse."

key_terms.الْمَسْأَلَةِ: the legal issue or question being asked
key_terms.غَلَبَ: overpowered or overcame beyond one’s ability
key_terms.يَقْضِي: to make up a missed religious duty

ai.seo_question: Does someone have to make up fasting and prayer if illness or incapacity overtook him beyond his control?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that a person does not need to make up sawm (fasting) or salat (prayer) when prevented by a condition beyond his control. It establishes the principle that when Allah causes a person to be overpowered by incapacity, the excuse is accepted.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1042 - Ali ibn Mahziyar asked about this issue, and Imam (as) replied:
"He does not have to make up the fasting (sawm) or the prayers (salat), and everything that overwhelms a person due to God's will, God is more deserving of granting the excuse."
